character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Andheri West has a distinct lifestyle energy. Mornings are unhurried in Lokhandwala and Yari Road, the afternoons hum with shooting schedules and café meetings, and evenings come alive with shopping, beach walks at Versova and a packed dining-and-nightlife scene. It's aspirational, creative and always switched-on. It's home to a strong entertainment-industry crowd, young professionals, NRIs and well-settled families - a cosmopolitan mix that gives Andheri West its trendy, fast-paced yet beachy character that's distinctly its own within the western suburbs.

faq.question: What is Andheri West known for?
faq.answer: Andheri West is known for Versova Beach, the upscale Lokhandwala Complex, the bustling DN Nagar and Four Bungalows markets, Yari Road's film fraternity, vibrant nightlife and shopping, and being one of Mumbai's most desirable residential and entertainment-industry hubs.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Andheri West?
faq.answer: Andheri West has multiple pin codes: 400058 (Andheri West / Four Bungalows), 400053 (DN Nagar / Versova), and 400061 (Madh / Versova belt).

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Andheri West?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Andheri West are Lokhandwala Complex, Versova, Four Bungalows, Seven Bungalows, DN Nagar, Oshiwara, Yari Road, JP Road and Veera Desai Road.

faq.question: What is the property price in Andheri West?
faq.answer: Property prices in Andheri West range from around ₹1.1–1.6 Cr for a 1BHK in DN Nagar/Four Bungalows to ₹2.2–3.5 Cr for a 2BHK in Lokhandwala/Versova, and higher for premium sea-facing flats. Rental rates range from ₹28,000 to ₹90,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Andheri West?
faq.answer: Andheri West is served by Western Railway's Andheri Station (30 min to Churchgate), Metro Line 1 (Versova–Ghatkopar) with the Versova, DN Nagar, Azad Nagar and Andheri stops, BEST bus routes, and direct access to JP Road, Link Road and SV Road. The airport is about 15–20 minutes away.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Andheri West?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Andheri West include Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital, Nanavati Max Hospital, SRV Hospital, Sujay Hospital and several multi-speciality clinics across Lokhandwala and Four Bungalows.

faq.question: Which schools are in Andheri West?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Andheri West include Ryan International School, Billabong High International School, Jamnabai Narsee School (nearby Juhu), St. Louis Convent High School and Oberoi International School (nearby).
